remarks: Tucked away on a quiet street in a coveted in-town neighborhood, this 4-bedroom colonial is an exquisite custom home built in 2020 that checks every box. Situated on a hill lined with stone walls and tasteful landscaping, sunshine pours into this home throughout the day. Step through the mahogany door to find soaring double height ceilings and 5-inch white oak floors. A chef's kitchen with a center island opens to a breakfast room with double sliding doors to an expansive stone terrace ideal for entertaining. Enjoy unmatched privacy on the sprawling second-floor primary suite, which includes a sitting room, flex space and balcony surrounded by lush greenery. From the 9-ft ceilings and heated floors to the Andersen windows and copper accents, this home is a beauty not to be missed.
